channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: Students protest against SIR at Mumbai University, demand arrest of CEC Gyanesh Kumar
item.description: Organised by the Disha Students’ Organisation and Bhagat Singh Jan Adhikar Yatra (BSJAY), the demonstration also called for the repeal of the 2023 law governing the appointment of Election Commissioners

item.title: Legal action ordered against officials over irregularities in voter list in Pilibhit
item.description: Legal action will be taken against both the current and former election officials responsible for the discrepancies found in the voter list for constituency 127 – Pilibhit, reads an official statement by the State election commission

item.title: CREDAI Chennai sets up anti-corruption panel, frames SOP for reporting graft
No local body polls in Amaravati capital region villages of Andhra Pradesh
item.description: Elections in villages where land pooling is under way have been kept pending for the time being as the government is working on a separate governance framework for the mega capital city

item.title: Local body polls: 14 cases booked on the last day of nominations, says Andhra Pradesh DGP
item.description: 36 platoons of Andhra Pradesh Special Police have been deployed as part of election bandobust

item.title: Three arrested for allegedly stealing two-wheelers in Amberpet
Cyclonic storm likely to hit North Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, says IMD
item.description: Red warnings for extremely heavy rain issued for October 27 and 28; fishermen who have ventured into the sea asked to return to shore

item.title: M.P. receives investment proposals of over ₹15,400 crore at semiconductor summit
item.description: Chief Minister Mohan Yadav said that the government also received proposals worth around ₹5,800 that have potential to generate around 10,000 employment opportunities

item.title: Bomb threat emails to Mumbai Mayor’s office, three Navi Mumbai schools trigger security alert
item.description: Prompted by the threat, law enforcement authorities have launched a comprehensive investigation to verify the authenticity of the message

item.title: CSR funds for sports development, better infrastructure on the anvil, says Minister
Pregnant minor gang-raped in Rajasthan; newborn dies after delivery in deserted area
item.description: Afterwards, she reached a hospital, where the newborn was declared dead, prompting the hospital administration to notify local police

item.title: Financial insecurity drives older people to seek jobs, survey in Bengaluru finds
item.description: Nearly half of senior jobseekers reporting employment barriers say employers prefer younger candidates

item.title: MPSC paper ‘leak’: Fourth Commission official arrested, total arrests rise to 13
item.description: The accused, identified as Rohit Kolatakke, an assistant section officer with the MPSC, allegedly obtained the confidential question set from Abhijit Lendve, an under-secretary with the commission, who was arrested earlier in the case

item.title: Karnataka braces for 21,000 MW power demand in summer next year
item.description: According to Energy Department data, Karnataka’s power demand peaked at 18,650 MW during the summer of 2025. It subsequently touched 20,000 MW in September 2026.

item.title: Agriculture pumpset power load increases by 25-50%, other categories by 18% amidst rain deficit in Karnataka
item.description: According to sources in the Energy Department, Karnataka’s average daily electricity consumption rose to 349-362 Million Units (MU) in the first two weeks of October 2026, surpassing the record of 340 MU recorded in September.

item.title: India denies rejecting Iran’s request to transport medicines
item.description: Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said, “We remain in contact with our Iranian counterparts to facilitate the transport of life-saving medicines as a humanitarian gesture.”

item.title: Shankarpally police deny forcing minor girl to undergo medical examination
Kerala artist Tom Vattakuzhy’s shows in London and Paris reflect the frailty of the human condition
item.description: Artist Tom Vattakuzhy on showing his works in strife-torn Paris, the excitement of Frieze Week in London and how he views his practice post the controversy surrounding his work at the Kochi Muziris Biennale

item.title: ‘Gem Granites’ Veeramani’s daughter detained from aircraft by SIT
item.description: Investigators took custody of Archana Veeramani after she boarded a flight at Chennai International Airport

item.title: Bharat Biotech slashes malaria vaccine price on GAVI-backed pact with UNICEF
Proposed driving licence rules raise the bar for learner’s test
item.description: As per draft amendments, applicants should secure 75% to pass preliminary test; licence-seekers will have to disclose more health information; there will be no fee to change licensee’s name, address

item.title: CoE on green skills, Applied AI opened
Punjab House passes resolution against electoral irregularities
item.description: Taking part in the discussion on the resolution on Day 2 of the Assembly session, Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann blamed the BJP for alleged vote ‘loot’, terming it dangerous for democracy, and demanded the scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls

item.title: Keralam government prioritising infrastructure development in fisheries sector, says Minister
item.description: Inaugurating development works completed at Puthiyappa and Koyilandy fishing harbours, Fisheries Minister V.E. Abdul Gafoor says govt. will continue to implement schemes aimed at improving the living standards of fishers

item.title: ACB traps Tulluru PHC medical officer while accepting ₹25,000 bribe
IndiGo extends cancellation of Saudi flights as regional tensions escalate: Indian mission
ANU faculty member wins Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar
Three Vizag kayakers selected for inter-university competitions
OCTOPUS IG urges students to cultivate discipline and courage
Society of Indian Screen Editors formed
item.description: Film editor Bina Paul is the chairperson

item.title: H.D. Kumaraswamy continues allegations against NICE road toll collection
Keralam to conduct Statewide child vulnerability mapping
item.description: Meeting decides that Women and Child Development Officers in districts will be fully responsible for ensuring children’s safety and rehabilitation.

item.title: Congress high command asks Karnataka CM to start probe into alleged sting operation attempt
item.description: The Chief Minister, in an interview with a Kannada television channel, had claimed that a businessman wearing Meta AI glasses recently met him in, what he suspected, was an attempted “sting operation.”

item.title: Jaishankar meets Azerbaijan President, Foreign Minister as India attempts reset of ties
item.description: Bilateral ties had soured with Azerbaijan’s condemnation of Operation Sindoor and calls for ‘resolution’ of the Kashmir issue; but on Friday, Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Bayramov highlighted trade, tourism, and energy ties after a ‘fruitful discussion’ with his Indian counterpart

item.title: Talks between Ladakh groups, MHA fail to resume amid rift over govt. proposal
item.description: Civil society groups differ over Centre’s 32-draft proposal for the Union Territory

item.title: Karnataka SIR: Teaching on the back burner
item.description: Children in government and aided schools across Karnataka have not seen several of their teachers for months, for most of them have been assigned as Booth Level Officers for the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Students tell Rishita Khanna that what initially seemed like fun with many free hours, is now making them anxious...

item.title: Telangana CM asks officials to be prepared to convince Maharashtra for 152 m FRL barrage at Tummidihatti
item.description: Revanth Reddy directs them to make arrangements to draw 0.6 tmc ft additional water from Srisailam for Dindi, Achampet projects by using PRLIS pumping system

item.title: Bharat Petroleum’s net profit dips amid volatile crude prices in Q2
item.description: Bharat Petroleum’s revenues spurred 29% whilst net profit declined 22.5% on a year-over-year basis in Q2

item.title: R. Senthamil Selvan is new chairperson of TNCC’s Scheduled Caste department
item.description: He replaces M.P. Ranjan Kumar, who had been holding the post for the last four-and-a-half years

item.title: At least four killed in blast at house storing firecrackers in Bihar’s Siwan
item.description: The blast occurred in a house where firecrackers were being made; rescue operations under way

item.title: PLA’s patrolling behaviour keeps LAC disturbed, Govt. says
item.description: MEA says “Chinese forces diverge from established patrolling patterns”; video of ITBP chief’s remarks on situation in Arunachal Pradesh removed after The Hindu’s report on the border situation; Congress slams government for suppressing information

item.title: Government to modify labour survey to capture gig economy, unpaid household workers
item.description: Periodic Labour Force Survey will include additional questions to measure labour underutilisation

item.title: Two workers killed in chloroform vapour leak at pharma unit, TGPCB orders closure
Vijay congratulates T.N. medallists of 5th Asian Para Games
item.description: The Tamil Nadu government will award an incentive to them in recognition of their achievements

item.title: Students, farmers, civil society groups continue to protest against SIR, CEC
item.description: Hundreds take to the streets as Yogendra Yadav, Annie Raja, and farmers’ groups join protest; police say 20 detained, one FIR resgistered

item.title: Protests against SIR updates: CJP leaders vow to continue SIR protest, say Gyanesh Kumar will have to resign
item.description: Police detained protesters during march to ECI HQ; Samyukt Kisan Morcha and ‘People Against SIR’ platform are protesting nationwide; various trade unions and civil society organisations have pledged support to the farmers’ march

item.title: Delhi High Court rejects Neha Bora's plea against police notice to sign peace bond
item.description: HC judge, however, says that he has passed certain directions to the special executive magistrate (SEM) on providing all material to the student leader in the proceedings

item.title: El Nino-induced water and power crisis likely to persist until July: Revanth
item.description: CM asks people to save water and power; special employment guarantee scheme after Sankranti, says people should adapt to the situation as they did during the pandemic

item.title: Navy to host Indo-Pacific Regional Dialogue in New Delhi from November 3
item.description: The 3-day event will bring together policymakers and experts from 18 countries seeking to identify practical measures to strengthen regional cooperation in maritime research, ocean governance, climate resilience and emerging technologies

item.title: Cabinet Sub-Committee seeks to draw up department-wise plan to tackle El Nino induced drought conditions
item.description: 358 mandals provisionally identified as drought-affected based on rainfall, crop coverage

item.title: Council polls for four seats pass off peacefully, but for minor incidents in Bengaluru
item.description: Of the total 3.43 lakh voters, 2.01 lakh voters cast their votes in the four constituencies that went into polls

item.title: Rajnath Singh stresses need for long-term vision, flexible strategies for the Army
item.description: Defence Minister calls for integrated approach to modern warfare and emphases that land operations and ground forces would remain indispensable despite the growing significance of air, maritime, space, and cyber domains

item.title: Kerala HC sets aside guidelines for producing accused before judicial officer after court hours
item.description: While retaining provisions requiring prior intimation to the magistrate in cases of production after 5 p.m., court directs the State government to issue fresh guidelines

item.title: BJP seeks all-party meet on El Nino impact
75.62% polling in West Graduates, 86.97% in North East Teachers constituency
item.description: Polling in 11 districts coming under the two Legislative Council segments conclude peacefully

item.title: Centre introduces AI-based verification upgrade in attendance app for rural jobs scheme
item.description: Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan says the upgraded National Mobile Moniroting System used to capture attendance of rural employment scheme will now have liveness detection, anti-tampering features and enhanced face verification

item.title: Crude oil sourcing presently volatile; procuring more on landed basis: HPCL Chief
item.description: Vikas Kaushal, Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) informed the state-owned OMC is procuring more on landed basis than on FOB basis and term contracts

item.title: Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis breaks silence over ₹500 crore claim by Maratha activist
item.description: Devendra Fadnavis says that the purported audio clip will be sent for forensic examination and that the truth will be brought out

item.title: Supreme Court holds voters can prosecute candidates for concealing information
item.description: The judgment by a Bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu said the law does not insist that only public servants or competent authorities were eligible to lodge complaints against electoral candidates

item.title: 853 persons donate blood as part of Police Commemoration Week in Adilabad
